interpretation: Completed registered validation with a frozen selected checkpoint; no final test outcomes used. Selection on these cases is optimistic and this is not an unbiased test estimate.
One training seed: uncertainty across paired resets does not measure training-seed variation.
Historical methods use a different world/representation and historical LeFlow has a known sampler restriction; these are method-family adaptations, not exact paper replicas or a corrected-SOTA claim.
Selected new-world CEM22/104 is an already-recorded same-world diagnostic, included without an extra evaluation.
Controller-timeout and primitive-action counts are observed stopping reasons. Physical causes and causal effects of latent scores are not established.
selection_rule: maximum fixed-validation macro success, earliest-step tie break

uncertainty.limits: Conditional descriptive intervals only. One training seed; no training-seed variation or task-generalization uncertainty. Checkpoint selection on these same cases is optimistic and not corrected by these intervals. Historical world/representation/sampler confounds remain. All-zero/all-one small strata have degenerate empirical resampling; these intervals do not establish unobserved success/failure probability.
uncertainty.method: paired reset resampling within each of 13 fixed task strata; 8 resets per task; same resampling indices for all methods
